newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK bourse approves Guangzhou Inv spinoff.
newsitem.headline: HK bourse approves Guangzhou Inv spinoff.

text.p: Guangzhou Investment Co Ltd said on Monday the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong had approved in principle the public listing of its spinoff GZI Transport Ltd, which holds the parent firm's China infrastructural projects.
But the financial effects in terms of additional NAV and profits are more likely to happen in 1997, the statement added.
After the listing, Guangzhou Investment's interest in GZI Transport will be reduced to not more than 38.25 percent from the present 51 percent.

New shares with warrants in the proportion of one GZI Transport warrant for every five GZI Transport shares will be offered by placing to international institutional investors and public offer in Hong Kong. The public offer includes a preferential offer to Guangzhou Investment shareholders, but details of their share entitlement had yet to be decided.
There will also be an over-allotment option to issue additional 15 percent of the new shares issued to be exercised by lead underwriter Peregrine.
GZI Transport has a total of six toll road projects mainly in southern China's Guangdong province.
Five of the six pojetcts will be fully operational and generating cashflow in 1997, the statement said.

It said a valuation conducted by an independent valuer shows that the fair market value of the six toll road projects based on future net cash flow amounts to about HK$2.80 billion, compared with a book cost of HK$1.85 billion.
The listing will provide GZI with additional financial resources to expand its toll road business quickly, it said.
The placing and public offer of GZI is subject to the approval of shareholders at an extraordinary general meeting in January, the statement said.
Guangzhou Investment is a China-funded company listed in Hong Kong.
